_comment: MeteredPay SECOND SELLER — READY, NOT REGISTERED. Public info ONLY: account id + public key. No private key, seed phrase, or credential material lives in this file or anywhere in the repo. The signing key is only in ~/.near-credentials/testnet/mp-seller2.testnet.json (never committed, never printed). Status 5 Nov 2026: the account exists on testnet (verified: view_access_key returns FullAccess for this key; balance 10 testnet NEAR from the faucet). It is NOT registered on the frozen contract apathetic-party.testnet — that contract registers exactly one seller at init (tedious-sea.testnet) and has no register-seller method, so this seller cannot receive a deduction from the frozen contract. It is ready to be registered at init on a redeployed contract instance: see MULTI_SELLER_RUNBOOK.md. Do NOT point a buyer at this seller against the frozen contract and expect a deduction — the contract will reject it (wrong_seller / Invalid seller signature).

run.command: cd seller-api && SELLER_ACCOUNT_ID=mp-seller2.testnet SELLER_KEY_PATH=$HOME/.near-credentials/testnet/mp-seller2.testnet.json CONTRACT_ID=<new-contract>.testnet PORT=8788 node server.mjs
run.note: The seller server refuses to start if its key does not match the key registered on-chain for CONTRACT_ID (SELLER_SPEC.md Appendix A3). Against the frozen contract it will refuse — that is the spec working as written, not a bug.
